Calendar Bridge companion

Connecting to Outlook…

Keep this tab open, then return to Outlook. Your Favourite scans the visible calendar and encrypts it there. This tab receives the encrypted envelope and uploads it to Calendar Bridge.

No Microsoft credentials or authentication tokens are accessed. Closing this tab stops uploads until you click the Favourite again.
